items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There's also a person's name in quotes here -- Clarence -- I can't even read it. Looks like Ysiquirre. Siquirri or something. [INTERVIEWEE] Actually, it's YsiquirrE.

ctx.x: Yes. In fact I've got a picture of it right over there in that book, and it has my group and me sitting on a railing with the guys (unintelligible by me), and it was taken at the Dunbar Palace Ballroom. So that name is incorrect -- whoever wrote that down
This is reported in the International Musician in May of '31. There's also a person's name in quotes here -- Clarence -- I can't even read it. Looks like Ysiquirre. Siquirri or something.
